title: [Feature] Add option to open collapsible based on isRefined
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**
Feature

**Feature: What is your use case for such a feature?**
Sometimes a refinement list might be collapsed by default, but if it has been refined and the user reloads the page, it would be nice to have it opened instead of collapsed.

![issue with collapsible refined](https://cl.ly/003T3V023G2r/Screen%20Recording%202017-03-29%20at%2006.17%20PM.gif)

**Feature: What is your proposed API entry? The new option to add? What is the behavior?**
Add a property in the `collapsible` object, like `collapsedIfRefined` with a boolean value (default `true` to not change existing behavior).
Expected usage based on current options would be something like this:
```js
search.addWidget(
  instantsearch.widgets.refinementList({
    ...
    collapsible: {
      collapsed: true,
      collapsedIfRefined: false
    }
  })
);
```

**What project are you opening an issue for?**
- instantsearch.js

**What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.**
Latest

comments.body:
Totally want this feature. 
Any kind of work around to implement this behaviour with current instantsearch?

~The problem is that for the moment InstantSearch.js only stores search related parameters in the URL and since it's a direct mapping of the internal state (only search related), it means some deep modifications.~

~We can add the API proposed by @julienpa but that's external thus this will force the developer to do the integration themselves, which can be tricky.~

My bad I misread the expected behavior, it's based on wether or not it's refined so it should be ok. We're gonna try to integrate soon :)
